verdict.rationale: Building custom AI agents is a fair capability to ask of a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no in-product agent builder or agent configuration. The pack only covers an MCP server and connections that let external agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI) work with Shortcut, a REST API that is a developer building block, and rule-based Automations, which are an adjacent feature. None of these let a user build or configure their own AI agent inside Shortcut.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
